title: Add ingest retention policy and release digest sampler
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Context: onboarding churn for model metadata has increased noisy changelogs and reprocessed probes because we currently store all ingest events indefinitely. This PR adds a configurable 'ingest_retention' policy to model metadata, a background digest sampler that produces compact release-note fragments and weekly digests, and a telemetry compactifier to downsample high-frequency probe signals. Motivation: reduce storage and downstream noise, enable concise automated release notes, and provide retention controls for compliance and cost. What changed: added schema field ingest_retention (enum + days), migration to populate a sane default, digest-sampler service with pluggable sampling strategies (uniform/windowed/priority by latency), telemetry compactifier that collapses bursty events into summarized buckets, onboarding docs and an automated release-note generator hook that emits short blurb candidates for reviewers. Testing: unit and integration tests for sampler strategies, migration smoke, compatibility tests for older metadata. Rollout plan: feature-flag sampler for 2 weeks on staging -> gradual rollout to 15% of intake traffic -> sweep to 100% after monitoring. Related tasks: ENG-1621, ENG-1798, PM-341. Impact: expected storage decrease (sampled simulation shows ~4x reduction for high-throughput models), lower churn in changelog drafts, no behavioral changes to model inference. Backwards compatibility: ingest_retention defaults to 'retain_365' for existing models; sampler is opt-in until flag removed.

review_comments: Diego Morales: Can the default retention be shorter for internal models? Suggest retain_90 as a follow-up flag to test cost impact.
Asha Kapoor: Reply: kept default as retain_365 for conservative behavior; added a Linear follow-up ENG-1845 to evaluate 90-day default via canary.
Priya Nair: Request changes: need explicit audit log entries when retention is changed and an RBAC check on the onboarding endpoint.
Asha Kapoor: Reply: added audit hooks and gated the API change under onboarding.update_metadata permission; updated tests to assert audit entries.
Lucas Chen: Suggestion: sampler priority strategy should prefer recent failed probes — add weighting by failure count.
release_notes: Add ingest_retention metadata and a release-digest sampler: admins can now configure retention windows per-model (default retain_365). A new background sampler produces concise changelog candidates and weekly digests, and a telemetry compactifier reduces probe event volume. Opt-in via feature flag during rollout.
